title: Starboard: a permanent macOS terminal beside your Dock, real zsh, always visible, never steals focus

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Starboard is a Mac OS terminal that sits permanently beside your dock, tracking its height and position live. Not a Quake style dropdown. There's no hotkey, no summon and dismiss cycle, and it never takes focus. It shows on every space, including over full screen apps, running a real persistent ZSH login shell, so directory and history carry across commands.
